name: Nadia Okafor
thesis: Solid-state electrolyte interfaces for next-generation lithium-metal batteries
transitionSignals: Filed first patent on electrolyte coating
description: Nadia is a 5th-year PhD candidate engineering stable solid-electrolyte interfaces that suppress dendrite growth. Her summer at a battery scale-up gave her hands-on cell-manufacturing experience that maps directly onto industry R&D roles.
